caveats: `--runtime-record` is NOT in the publication set. Everything else reproduces from the publication set and the chain alone

deterministic Benchmark-v2 admission (validator step 5) needs the private benchmark-v2 and coretex-memory trees and BACKLOGs on a clean machine; that gap is carried in the validator's export rather than worked around
